# Miss Barry

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P91](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0091), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P94](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0094), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P17](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0017)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Diana](../character/diana.md) (relative)

## Appearance

Miss Barry is an old woman with wrinkled cheeks. Despite her age, her vigor is unabated and her sharp black eyes remain bright and undimmed.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P17](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0017), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P31](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0031), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P8](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0008)_

## Personality

Miss Barry is a somewhat selfish woman who historically cared little for anyone other than herself. Despite this self-centered nature, she is a most hospitable host who treats her guests royally.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P26](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0026), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P31](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0031)_

## History

Miss Barry was a selfish old lady who had rarely cared for anyone other than herself. While visiting Diana's home, she was infuriated after [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) unwittingly jumped onto her in the spare-room bed as a game, an incident that caused an uproar and threatened Diana's music lessons. She later resided at [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood), where [Anne](../character/anne.md) regularly visited her in her spare time while attending Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P2](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. ## Relationships

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--miss-barry.md)

Miss Barry first encounters [Anne](../character/anne.md) under chaotic circumstances when [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) accidentally jump on her in a spare-room bed, infuriating her. However, Anne's candid apology sways Miss Barry, leading to a strong friendship where Miss Barry later welcomes [Anne](../character/anne.md) to her home, [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood), during Anne's time at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy). Over time, Miss Barry expresses deep pride in Anne's academic achievements as [Anne](../character/anne.md) advances in her studies.

- Friend of — expresses deep pride in her achievements  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P13](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P8](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P16](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0016)</sub>

### [Diana](../character/diana.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana--miss-barry.md)

Miss Barry is Diana's great-aunt Josephine. Their relationship is briefly strained when [Diana](../character/diana.md) and [Anne](../character/anne.md) disrupt her sleep by leaping into her bed, causing an uproar that threatens Diana's music lessons. Despite this initial outburst, Miss Barry remains an influential figure in Diana's social circle, hosting visitors and maintaining family ties through [Anne](../character/anne.md) and Diana's school years.

- Relative of — aunt  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P23](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0023)</sub>
